## Recall · Lecture 6

a) Which extension does a save file have?
b) How much free storage does the device check ask for?
c) The phone charges, but the PC shows no files. What do you change?

::: {.answer}
a) .sav
b) at least 2 GB
c) the USB mode to file transfer
:::

## Activity 1 · Copy and name · 15 min

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- A good file name has the date first, the device and what the file shows.
- **Do it:** Make the folder Tests\\PocketQuest_1.2\\screenshots. Copy a screenshot from your phone into it and rename it.
- Your product is one renamed screenshot in the right folder.
:::

![](images/test-folder.png)

## Check 1 · Copy and name

What does a good result look like?

::: {.reveal}
1. The file is in Documents\\Tests\\PocketQuest_1.2\\screenshots.
2. Its name is like 2026-11-12_A35_home.png: the date, the phone and what it shows.
3. The copy is checked on the PC before the file is deleted from the phone.
:::

## Check 2 · The device check

What does Rami do to make P5 ready?

::: {.reveal}
1. He deletes old videos and clears caches, so P5 has more than 2 GB free.
2. He charges the battery above 50 %.
3. He closes the other apps and keeps only the game open.
4. He turns on Do not disturb, so no call stops the test.
:::

## Wrap-up

- You can copy a file from a phone into a test folder and give it a clear name.
- You can make a phone ready for a test with the device check.
